function: S-RISnet NN (unsupervised) predicts RIS phase shifts from partial historical channel samples to maximize sum rate; a random-forest change-point detector triggers covariance and phase updates (p. 4-8).
system: Downlink SDMA: 3x3-antenna BS, single-antenna UEs (U=4 in CPD tests), passive reflecting 36x36 RIS with few channel-estimating anchor elements, 3.5 GHz, 64 subcarriers (p. 3, 6, 9, 11).
method: S-RISnet: permutation-invariant NN with shared processing units, unsupervised sum-rate maximization by gradient ascent alternating with WMMSE precoding; random-forest regressor predicts covariance correlation for change detection (p. 4-8).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray tracing, Outdoor dense-urban scenario at 3.5 GHz; users on mobile and stationary tracks in a 40x35 m area; non-overlapping train/test positions (p. 9-10).
test_conditions: Training: 20,480 S-RISnet samples and 8,000 AD-trigger samples (area UE1); testing: 1,024 and 2,000 samples at different random user positions, i.i.d. with training; no other scenario (p. 10).
baselines: Non-learned: random, periodic and no-update schemes, plus oracle references (optimal, correlation-based CPD); learned: RF versus PR, SVR, XGBoost for correlation prediction; no other RIS-configuration baseline (p. 8-9, 11).
metrics: Sum-rate (bit/s/Hz) over epochs; correlation prediction accuracy (%) and computation time; estimation and computation overhead counts per track (p. 11-13).
complexity: Measured regressor computation time (RF 136 ms, Table II, p. 11); S-RISnet inference only said linear in RIS elements, by citation (p. 6); no FLOPs or orders.
openness: none released by the authors; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset (p. 9)
q1_support: p. 9: "using the open-source raytracing dataset generation tool, DeepMIMO"; Outdoor dense urban scenario at 3.5 GHz, used for training and testing (p. 10, Table I).
q2_support: p. 10: "training and testing sets are independent identically distributed (i.i.d.)"; test samples are held-out user positions of the same scenario, and generalization to indoor or mmWave is only claimed on p. 9, not tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "different regression algorithms are compared: RF, PR, SVR, and XGBoost" (learned, accuracy in Table II); p. 12: "Both methods significantly outperform the random and periodic update" schemes (non-learned, sum rate, Fig. 9).
q4_support: p. 11: footnote 3 says "The computation time is measured on a MacBook Pro"; Table II (read as an image) gives the time per regressor, RF 136.0 ms; the S-RISnet cost is only qualitative (p. 6).
q5_support: p. 9: "using the open-source raytracing dataset generation tool, DeepMIMO"; a public ray-tracing dataset of channels, although the authors release no code of their own.
notes: Area 3: S-RISnet sets the RIS phase shifts (main metric sum rate, Figs. 5 and 9); the random-forest detector only decides when to update the covariance, so not area 2. q3 and q4 are borderline: q3 rests on RF versus PR/SVR/XGBoost accuracy (Table II) and on update policies (Fig. 9), while S-RISnet itself is compared only with its own variants (Figs. 5, 12); q4 rests on the measured regressor times (Table II), and the overhead counts of Fig. 11 are not counted. Tables I and II read as images.
